_about: Garathorm Vineyard: the vintner's house, his cellar rats, and the giant wine spider that has taken the storage room.

41800.name: vintner old
41800.long_desc: The old vintner sits on the edge of his bed, worrying about his cellar.
41800.description: Purple-stained hands and a red nose, and a look of real fear whenever his eyes go to the cellar stair. Something has taken his best vintages, and he dares not go down.

41801.name: rat cellar
41801.long_desc: A fat cellar rat gnaws at the bung of a cask.
41801.description: Sleek and bold from a diet of spilled wine and grape skins.

41802.name: spider wine giant
41802.long_desc: A giant wine spider hangs in its web among the bottle racks, its belly the colour of claret.
41802.description: A bloated spider as big as a cart, its swollen abdomen stained a deep wine-red. Wrapped bottles and wrapped rats hang in its web like fruit.

41890.room_desc: A vintner's corkscrew knife lies here.
41890.description: A folding knife with a curved blade on one side and a steel corkscrew on the other, its horn handle stained purple.

41891.description: A squat iron lantern with a hood to keep its light low, so as not to warm the casks.

41892.short_desc: a nibbled wedge of cellar cheese
41892.room_desc: A nibbled wedge of cheese lies here.
41892.description: A wedge of hard, tangy cheese of the kind kept in the cellar beside the wine, gnawed around the rind.

41893.short_desc: a dusty bottle of Garathorm red
41893.room_desc: A dusty bottle of wine lies here.
41893.description: A cobwebbed bottle of the vineyard's best red, many years in the rack. A long swallow puts heart back into a body.

41894.room_desc: A grey cloak of spider silk lies here.
41894.description: A light, strong cloak cut from the giant wine spider's web, grey and faintly sticky. It moves with you like a shadow.
